era: 1828-1910 : 俄国（雅斯纳亚·波良纳贵族童年—高加索从军与塞瓦斯托波尔—战前欧洲旅行—《战争与和平》《安娜·卡列尼娜》巅峰期—精神危机与《忏悔录》—社会批判与民间故事—《复活》—1910 年离家出走卒于阿斯塔波沃）
era_en: 1828-1910 : Russia (noble childhood at Yasnaya Polyana - service in the Caucasus and Sevastopol - pre-war European travels - the summit years of War and Peace and Anna Karenina - spiritual crisis and A Confession - social criticism and folk tales - Resurrection - the flight of 1910 ending at Astapovo station)
school: 俄国批判现实主义 / 心灵辩证法 / 托尔斯泰主义（非暴力与简朴）
historical_significance: 列夫·托尔斯泰（1828-1910），伯爵、雅斯纳亚·波良纳庄园主、俄国批判现实主义与道德思想的双峰。克里米亚战争从军后以《塞瓦斯托波尔故事》成名；《战争与和平》（1863-1869）以五百余人物与双焦距全景把小说变成历史哲学，《安娜·卡列尼娜》（1873-1877）以『心灵的辩证法』把心理写实推到极限。中年精神危机后写《忏悔录》（1882），否定自己全部艺术成就并以死亡为尺重建人生；此后四十年执行临终清算：解放农奴、办学、分产、捐版权、主张非暴力不服从（《天国在你心中》，1894）与艺术道德同审（《什么是艺术？》，1897）、写作《伊凡·伊里奇之死》《复活》与民间故事，1910 年以八十一岁离家出走，卒于阿斯塔波沃车站。他是甘地与马丁·路德·金的非暴力方法源头、什克洛夫斯基『陌生化』诗学的直接师承，也是俄国文学黄金时代的最高峰之一。他的方法论——巨细全景、反英雄史观、心灵辩证、极限测试、陌生化复眼、艺术道德同审、让步实验、非暴力不服从、简一律写作、临终清算——构成一个以『以死为尺、以真为法』为核心的完整思想体系。
historical_significance_en: Leo Tolstoy (1828-1910), count and master of Yasnaya Polyana, stands at the twin summit of Russian critical realism and moral thought. After serving in the Crimean War he made his name with the Sevastopol Sketches; War and Peace (1863-1869) turned the novel into a philosophy of history through five hundred characters and a double-focal panorama, and Anna Karenina (1873-1877) carried psychological realism to its limit with the 'dialectic of the soul.' After a midlife spiritual crisis he wrote A Confession (1882), repudiating his entire artistic achievement and rebuilding life with death as its ruler; the following decades executed a deathbed liquidation—freeing serfs, founding schools, distributing property, donating copyrights, preaching nonviolence (The Kingdom of God Is Within You, 1894) and the moral audit of art (What Is Art?, 1897), writing The Death of Ivan Ilyich, Resurrection, and the folk tales—and in 1910, aged eighty-one, he left home to die at Astapovo station. He is the source of the nonviolent method of Gandhi and Martin Luther King, the direct teacher of Shklovsky's poetics of estrangement, and one of the peaks of the Russian golden age. His methodology—the panoramic-microscopic, the anti-great-man, the dialectic of the soul, the limit probe, the defamiliarizing eye, the moral cointegration of art, the concession experiment, nonviolent noncooperation, the law of simplicity, and the deathbed self-audit—constitutes a complete system with 'death as the ruler, truth as the method' at its core.
unique_thinking: 把死亡装进决策当折现率：别人把死亡当成回避的终点，他把『临终之眼』当审计工具，逐日重估自己的持有并在贬值处动手转让——从艺术成就、财产到家族荣誉，一路清算到把自己从贵族身份里整体退出（81 岁离家出走）；同时清醒警惕清算本身沦为道德表演，用日记做防表演装置。他一生同时执行望远镜与显微镜：看清了历史的总和结构，就不再相信伟人叙事；看清了体面的溶解液，就先把自己放进去。
unique_thinking_en: Install death in decision-making as a discount rate: where others treat death as an endpoint to avoid, he made 'deathbed eyes' an auditing tool, repricing his holdings daily and acting at every point of depreciation—transferring from artistic achievement and property all the way to family honor, until he exited his aristocratic identity wholesale (leaving home at eighty-one); while keeping lifelong vigil against the liquidation itself becoming moral performance, his diaries serving as the anti-performance device. All his life he held telescope and microscope at once: seeing history's aggregate structure, he stopped believing in great-man narratives; seeing the solvent of respectability, he placed himself in it first.
civilization_en: Russian civilization (the turn of the 19th-20th centuries)

name_zh: 综合方法/望远镜与显微镜同持
name_en: 综合方法/望远镜与显微镜同持
category: 综合方法/望远镜与显微镜同持
modes.domain_zh: 同时握住望远镜与显微镜：在最宏观的历史全景（战争、王朝、民族命运）与最微观的瞬间细节（一次心跳、一个下意识的微笑、一支蜡烛的火苗）之间不断切换焦距。全景不靠俯瞰地图获得，而是靠无限多双个体眼睛的视线缝合而成
modes.domain_en: Holding the telescope and the microscope at once: switching focal length continuously between the grandest historical panorama (wars, dynasties, the fate of nations) and the most microscopic instant of detail (a heartbeat, an involuntary smile, the flame of a candle). The panorama is not obtained from a bird's-eye map but sewn together out of the sightlines of infinitely many individual eyes
modes.definition_zh: 《战争与和平》是文学史上最极端的一次焦距实验：五百多个有名有姓的人物、十五年的欧洲命运，托尔斯泰不写战场『全景俯瞰图』，而是把镜头贴到尼古拉·罗斯托夫第一次上战场的眼睛高度——他看见的不是战役而是河、不是敌军而是冲锋的瞬间与脚下的桥。方法论内核有三：其一，双焦距强制交替——宏大判断（历史走向何方）必须从微观积累中长出，微观细节必须回扣宏观命题，任何焦距停留过久都是失败：只看全景得到空洞的历史教科书，只看细节得到琐屑的笔记。其二，视点的民主化——全景不是统帅的地图而是无数普通人的视线总和：库图佐夫的沉稳来自他知道战争不是他的意志而是千万士兵意志的总和，这个历史观本身就是焦距方法的哲学推论。其三，缝合成命——散点必须最终收束为整体节奏：四大家族的线索像织布一样交替上升，读者在数十次换焦后自行『看见』了全景，作者只负责保证每一段换焦的精确。深意在于：对复杂巨系统的真正理解，属于能在两个极端尺度间自由换档的人，而不是任何单一尺度上的专家。代价是：这种写法的容量要求近乎残酷（他写到第三卷才被认可），且换焦的缝隙稍有差错全景即散架。现代对应物是复杂系统分析（微观个体行为如何涌现为宏观模式）、纪录片的长镜头与特写交替、以及产品研究中『大数据与小数据并用法』。
modes.definition_en: War and Peace is the most extreme focal-length experiment in literary history: five hundred named characters, fifteen years of European destiny—and Tolstoy never paints a battlefield from an 'aerial panorama.' He presses the lens to the eye-height of Nikolai Rostov on his first campaign, where the boy sees not a battle but a river, not an enemy army but the instant of the charge and the bridge underfoot. The method has three cores. First, forced alternation of focal lengths: the grand judgment (where is history going) must grow out of micro-accumulation, and every micro-detail must answer back to the macro-question; to linger at either focus is to fail—an overview alone yields an empty history textbook, detail alone a cluttered notebook. Second, the democratization of viewpoint: the panorama is not the commander's map but the sum of countless ordinary gazes; Kutuzov's poise comes from knowing that war is not his will but the sum of millions of soldiers' wills—a philosophy of history that is itself a corollary of the focal method. Third, sewing into a whole: the scattered points must close into an overall rhythm; the four family threads rise alternately like warp and weft, and after dozens of refocusings the reader 'sees' the panorama on his own, the author guaranteeing only the precision of each shift. The deeper point: true understanding of a vast complex system belongs to whoever can shift freely between the extreme scales, not to the specialist of any single scale. The cost: the capacity demanded is brutal (he was fully recognized only from volume three), and one careless seam and the panorama falls apart. Modern analogues: complex-systems analysis (how micro-behaviors emerge as macro-patterns), documentary alternation of long shot and close-up, and the 'big data and small data together' discipline in product research.
modes.source_chapter: 《战争与和平》（1863-1869）第二部开篇及尼古拉·罗斯托夫申格拉本战役章节；《安娜·卡列尼娜》赛马章
modes.key_quote_zh: 战争不是统帅地图上的箭头，而是千万双眼睛里同时发生的恐惧、饥饿与勇气——要看见全景，先俯身到最低的那双眼睛。
modes.key_quote_en: War is not the arrows on a commander's map but the fear, hunger, and courage happening at once in millions of eyes—to see the panorama, first bend to the lowest pair of eyes.
process_zh: 定住宏观问题：先明确全景要回答的命题（战争为何这样走向、时代往何处去），使所有微观采集有归依而不流散
俯身到最低视点：把镜头压到最小尺度——具体的人、具体的瞬间、具体的感官数据，拒绝用概括词替代观察
强制换焦校验：每积累一批微观素材，就回拉焦距检验它对宏观命题的贡献；每形成一个宏观判断，就下探寻找能否被微观证据支撑
缝合检查：通读全部换焦段落，确认散点已连成整体节奏、全景是读者自己『看见』的而非作者宣讲的
process_en: Fix the macro-question: state clearly what proposition the panorama must answer (why the war went as it did, where the era is heading), so every micro-gathering has a home and will not drift
Bend to the lowest viewpoint: press the lens to the smallest scale—a particular person, a particular instant, particular sensory data; refuse summary words in place of observation

Forced refocus checks: after each batch of micro-material, pull back the focus to test its contribution to the macro-question; after each macro-judgment, descend to seek the micro-evidence that could support it
Seam inspection: read through all the refocused passages and confirm the scattered points form one rhythm and the panorama is something readers see for themselves, not something the author announces
representative_cases_zh: 申格拉本战役：全书最重要的『战役』写作全是低视角——潮湿的森林、炮手的脸、冲锋时的耳语般的恐惧，战后读者对整个战局的理解反而比对任何教科书都清楚
库图佐夫的写法：托尔斯泰故意不写他的运筹帷幄，写他打盹、流泪、听士兵说话——统帅的全部智慧被翻译成最低焦距的身体细节
安娜卧轨前的最后之旅：城市全景、街头招牌、马车的拥挤与一个女人的内心崩溃在同一段落里交替换焦——宏观与微观在同一分钟内互为镜像
反例警示：十九世纪通行的大历史叙事（英雄传与王朝编年）——只有望远镜没有显微镜，全景因缺少任何一双真实眼睛而变成空话
representative_cases_en: The Schöngrabern campaign: the novel's most important battle-writing is all low-angle—damp woods, the gunners' faces, the whisper-like terror of the charge—leaving the reader with a clearer sense of the whole campaign than any textbook gives

The portrayal of Kutuzov: Tolstoy deliberately writes no grand strategizing, only his dozing, his tears, his listening to soldiers—an entire commander's wisdom translated into body-detail at the lowest focal length

Anna's final ride to the station: the panorama of the city, the street signs, the crush of carriages, and one woman's inner collapse alternate within the same paragraphs—macro and micro mirroring each other minute by minute

Counter-case: the grand nineteenth-century historical narrative (heroic biography and dynastic chronicle)—telescope without microscope, a panorama that becomes empty words for lacking any real pair of eyes
modern_applications_zh: 战略研究：分析行业格局时强制配对『一家具体公司的具体一天』的一手材料，防止战略报告沦为箭头图
复杂系统建模：用个体级模拟（agent-based）涌现出宏观规律，再回检宏观假设是否与个体数据一致
新闻与纪录片写作：宏观议题（战争、贫富）必须锚定在具体人物的具体一天里，以最低焦距保证可信度
产品研究：定量大盘与单用户深访强制交替阅读，任何宏观结论出现前先问它能否被一个真实用户的行为解释
modern_applications_en: Strategy research: when analyzing an industry, force-pair the macro picture with first-hand material of 'one specific company's one specific day,' keeping strategy reports from becoming arrow diagrams
Complex-systems modeling: let individual-level simulation (agent-based) surface macro-regularities, then check macro hypotheses back against individual data
Journalism and documentary writing: anchor every macro subject (war, inequality) in one particular person's one particular day; the lowest focal length buys credibility
Product research: alternate readings of quantitative dashboards and single-user deep interviews; before any macro conclusion, ask whether one real user's behavior could explain it

name_zh: 批判方法/历史动力的还原
name_en: 批判方法/历史动力的还原
category: 批判方法/历史动力的还原
modes.domain_zh: 把历史的动力从『伟人意志』还原为『无限多个普通人意志的总和』：拿破仑的命令不是历史的原因而是无数意愿汇聚后贴上的标签。历史学的因果方向必须倒转——不是英雄推动群众，而是群众的总和造出了『英雄』这个位置
modes.domain_en: Reducing the motive force of history from 'great-man will' to 'the sum of infinitely many ordinary wills': Napoleon's order is not the cause of history but a label pasted on after the convergence of countless volitions. The causal direction of historiography must be inverted—not heroes moving the masses, but the mass-total creating the very position called 'hero'
modes.definition_zh: 《战争与和平》第二部的开篇是一场对历史学的正面进攻：托尔斯泰逐条清算『英雄史观』的论证漏洞——历史学家把一件事的结果拿来倒推，把拿破仑的每一句话都读成命令，把博罗季诺的伤亡算在一个人头上；而真实发生的是：每一道命令传达到士兵时已被磨损、改写、抵抗，战役是千万个不可见的小决定的乘积。方法论内核有三：其一，因果的加总还原——凡被归于单一意志的宏观事件，追问它的每一层执行链：命令在哪一步变成了别的什么？动力实际来自哪一层？其二，自由与必然的分级——个人在自己的尺度上有自由，在历史的尺度上只是必然的颗粒；混淆两个尺度就产生『伟人幻觉』：拿破仑自以为在下命令，其实是在替总和签名。其三，警惕结果倒推——历史学的职业病灶是拿已知结局倒推『必然如此』，方法上的解毒剂是回到决策时点，站在当时的信息条件下重问一次。深意在于：任何『关键人物』叙事都应被视为待审计的加总简化——伟人是历史的光学幻象，如同远看时密集的雨点连成的银线。代价是：这个史观取消了个人的戏剧性，与他自己的小说技法（必须有具体的人）形成内在张力，他只能用库图佐夫式的『被动智慧』人物来给这个史观一张脸。现代对应物是群体动力学的涌现解释、经济学对『CEO神话』的统计检验与历史学的后修姆主义因果观。
modes.definition_en: The opening of Book Two of War and Peace is a frontal assault on historiography: Tolstoy itemizes the logical holes of the great-man view—historians reverse-engineer from outcomes, read Napoleon's every sentence as command, charge one man with the casualties of Borodino; whereas what actually happened was that every order, reaching a soldier, had been worn down, rewritten, resisted—and the battle was the product of millions of invisible small decisions. The method has three cores. First, aggregate reduction of causation: for any macro-event attributed to a single will, interrogate every layer of its execution chain—at which step did the command become something else? from which layer did the force really come? Second, the tiering of freedom and necessity: the individual has freedom at his own scale and is only a grain of necessity at history's scale; confusing the two scales produces the 'great-man illusion'—Napoleon believed he was giving orders when he was really signing for the total. Third, guard against backward inference from results: the occupational disease of historiography is deriving 'it had to be so' from a known ending; the methodological antidote is to return to the decision point and ask again under the information conditions of that moment. The deeper point: every 'key figure' narrative should be treated as an aggregate simplification pending audit—the great man is an optical illusion of history, like the silver thread rain-drops make when seen from afar. The cost: this view cancels personal drama and stands in internal tension with his own fictional craft (which needs concrete persons); he could give it a face only through Kutuzov-style figures of 'passive wisdom.' Modern analogues: emergent explanation in group dynamics, the statistical auditing of the 'CEO myth' in economics, and the post-Humean view of causation in historiography.
modes.source_chapter: 《战争与和平》第二部第一篇开篇历史论；《跋草》论自由与必然
modes.key_quote_zh: 拿破仑越是自负其令行禁止，越证明他只是替千万意志的总和在文件上签字。
modes.key_quote_en: The more Napoleon prided himself on his orders being obeyed, the more he proved that he was only signing papers for the sum of a million wills.
process_zh: 找出『伟人标签』：列出被归于单一人物的宏观结果（胜利、危机、转折），把它标记为待审计的简化
追踪命令磨损链：沿着执行链逐层追问——指令在哪一层被改写、抵抗、稀释？真实动力在哪一层积累？
分级检验自由：区分当事人自身尺度上的选择与历史尺度上的必然颗粒，重新安放责任与夸功
回到决策时点重问：剔除结果信息，站在当时的条件下重估各选项——凡只有事后才能看清的『英明』都降级为运气或加总
process_en: Locate the 'great-man label': list the macro-outcomes attributed to one person (victory, crisis, turning point) and mark them as simplifications pending audit
Trace the command-wear chain: along the execution chain, ask layer by layer—where was the instruction rewritten, resisted, diluted? where did the real force accumulate?
Tier the freedom test: distinguish the agent's choices at his own scale from the grain of necessity at history's scale; reassign both blame and credit accordingly

Re-ask at the decision point: strip out outcome information and re-evaluate the options under the conditions of that moment; any 'brilliance' visible only in hindsight is downgraded to luck or aggregation
representative_cases_zh: 博罗季诺战役的写法：拿破仑在远处山丘上『观看』一场他无法指挥的战役——命令与结果的断裂被具象化为一幅他看不懂的风景
库图佐夫与拿破仑的对照：一个顺应总和、一个强推意志；小说让顺应者胜利，正是反英雄史观的叙事判决
托尔斯泰的历史论战文（《论历史科学的统一》等）：把历史学的方法病灶写成方法论檄文——小说之外的同一战役
反例警示：同期流行的拿破仑传记文学——把滑铁卢解释为『一个人的失误』，正是不可能加总检验的标本
representative_cases_en: The writing of Borodino: Napoleon 'watches' from a far hill a battle he cannot command—the rupture between order and outcome rendered as a landscape he cannot read
The Kutuzov-Napoleon contrast: one rides the total, the other pushes his will; the novel lets the rider of the total win—the narrative verdict of the anti-great-man view
Tolstoy's essayistic war on history (essays on the unity of historical science): the methodological pathology of historiography written as a polemic—the same battle fought outside the novel
Counter-case: the fashionable Napoleonic biographies of his day explaining Waterloo as 'one man's mistake'—specimens of exactly what aggregate audit would refuse
modern_applications_zh: 组织诊断：把『一人扭转公司』的叙事替换为命令磨损链审计——找出现金流、执行、文化各自贡献了什么
公共政策评估：任何改革归功/归咎于领导者的结论，先做加总还原——制度、时机、基层执行各占多少权重
投资研究：对明星基金经理与明星CEO的超额收益做统计拆分，剔除事后倒推的叙事加成
团队管理：把成功归档到流程与人心的总和，防止单点英雄叙事带来的关键人依赖与激励扭曲
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnosis: replace the 'one man turned the company around' narrative with a command-wear chain audit—what did cash flow, execution, and culture each contribute?
Public-policy evaluation: before crediting or blaming leaders for reforms, run the aggregate reduction—institutional design, timing, and frontline execution each carry how much weight?
Investment research: statistically decompose star fund managers' and star CEOs' excess returns, stripping out hindsight narrative premium
Team management: file success under the sum of process and morale, preventing single-hero narratives that create key-person dependence and distorted incentives

modes.domain_zh: 不满足于写『一个人感到什么』，而写『他在感到的同时如何评判自己的感受』：嫉妒者一边嫉妒一边憎恶自己的嫉妒，撒谎者一边撒谎一边听见自己心里的辩解。心灵不是单层的情绪流，而是情绪与对情绪的评论互相缠绕的辩证场
modes.domain_en: Not content to write 'what a person feels,' it writes 'how he judges his own feeling while feeling it': the jealous man envies and loathes his envy at once, the liar lies while hearing his own mind's excuses. The soul is not a single-layer stream of emotion but a dialectical field where feeling and commentary on feeling entangle each other
modes.definition_zh: 车尔尼雪夫斯基把这个方法命名为『心灵的辩证法』，并举出典型段落：聂赫留朵夫打猎的段落里，动作被暂停、心理被无限放大——期待、失望、自嘲、再度期待，一层包着一层。方法论内核有三：其一，二级监测——任何一级情绪（愤怒、爱慕、恐惧）都不是终点，必须写出主体对这情绪的即时反应（羞耻、辩护、压抑），而二级反应又生成三级：心灵像没有底的回声井，写作者的任务是沿井壁下行到读者从未承认过的深度。其二，自欺的显影——人对自己说谎的方式不是直线的假话而是绕行的修辞：托尔斯泰擅长写出人物『诚实地说出不诚实的理由』的时刻，如卡列宁的宽恕里混着对体面的计算——道德判断因此必须迟疑。其三，以身体为锚——纯心理的独白会飘，托尔斯泰让每个心理转折都挂在一个身体细节上（手部的动作、呼吸的节律、目光的躲闪），使不可见的辩证获得可见的证物。深意在于：真实人格的深度不在于他感受什么，而在于他如何处理自己的感受——处理层才是性格、也是道德的所在地。代价是：这种写法要求作者对自己同样执行二级监测（他的日记就是这项工作的实验室），且极易滑向无限内向而失去叙事速度，他晚期短篇被迫用情节做骨架来拴住心理风暴。现代对应物是认知行为疗法对『元认知』的训练、内窥式写作（self-writing）与用户研究中『说出的理由与真实动机』的双层记录。
modes.definition_en: Chernyshevsky named this method 'the dialectic of the soul,' citing the hunting passages where action is suspended and psychology dilated without limit—expectation, disappointment, self-mockery, expectation renewed, each layer wrapping the last. The method has three cores. First, second-order monitoring: no first-order emotion (anger, tenderness, fear) is terminal; the subject's immediate reaction to the emotion (shame, self-defense, suppression) must be written—and that second order generates a third: the soul is an echo-well without a bottom, and the writer's task is to descend its wall to depths readers have never admitted. Second, developing the print of self-deception: people lie to themselves not in straight untruths but in detouring rhetoric; Tolstoy excels at moments when a character 'honestly gives a dishonest reason'—as in Karenin's forgiveness, mixed with calculation of decorum—so that moral judgment must hesitate. Third, anchoring in the body: purely psychological monologue drifts; Tolstoy hangs each mental turn on a bodily detail (the motion of a hand, the rhythm of breath, the dodging of a gaze), giving the invisible dialectic visible evidence. The deeper point: the depth of a real personality lies not in what he feels but in how he handles his feelings—the handling layer is where character, and morality, live. The cost: the method demands the author run second-order monitoring on himself (his diaries were the laboratory of exactly this work), and it slides easily toward infinite inwardness at the expense of narrative speed; his late stories had to tie the psychological storm to the mast of plot. Modern analogues: CBT training in metacognition, introspective self-writing, and the two-layer recording of 'stated reasons vs real motives' in user research.
modes.source_chapter: 车尔尼雪夫斯基《〈童年〉与〈少年〉、列·尼·托尔斯泰伯爵战争小说集》（1856）论『心灵辩证法』；《安娜·卡列尼娜》通奸暴露与卧轨章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 写下他感到什么不算本领；要写他在感到的同时如何厌恶、辩护、修剪这份感受——人是在处理层上成为自己的。
modes.key_quote_en: To write what he feels is no feat; write how, while feeling it, he loathes, defends, and prunes the feeling—a person becomes himself at the layer of handling.
process_zh: 捕捉一级情绪：先如实记录当事人此刻的第一感受（愤怒/动心/恐惧），不修饰不辩护
开启二级监测：立刻追问『他对这个感受做什么』——羞耻？辩护？压抑？夸大？把第二层写出来
追捕自欺修辞：检查第二层里有没有绕行的话术（『我这是为他好』『我只是不甘心而已』），标出真诚与算计的混合处
身体锚定与回扣：给每个心理转折配一个可观察的身体细节，然后回拉叙事速度，防止内向无限化
process_en: Catch the first-order emotion: faithfully record the person's immediate feeling right now (anger, stirrings, fear), unadorned and undefended
Open second-order monitoring: at once ask 'what does he do with this feeling'—shame? excuse? suppression? exaggeration? Write the second layer out
Hunt the rhetoric of self-deception: check the second layer for detouring phrases ('it's for his own good,' 'I'm merely unwilling to yield'), marking where sincerity and calculation mix
Anchor in body and reel back: attach an observable bodily detail to every mental turn, then pull narrative speed back, preventing infinite inwardness
representative_cases_zh: 安娜在赛马场失态：全场的目光与社交规则压着她，她的崩溃在『感到—羞耻—更深的感到』三级层叠中完成——心理辩证法最著名的公开演出
卡列宁的宽恕：一份被体制与教义调用的宽恕，每一句都诚实、每一句都绕开真实动机——自欺显影的教科书
聂赫留朵夫打猎章：动作暂停、心理放大到极限的段落，车尔尼雪夫斯基以此立论『心灵的辩证法』
托尔斯泰日记（1847-1910，五十余年）：对自己的虚荣、淫念、伪善执行与小说人物同级的二级监测——方法的自体实验
representative_cases_en: Anna's collapse at the races: the crowd's gaze and social rules press upon her, and her breakdown completes itself in a three-tier cascade of feeling-shame-deeper feeling—the dialectic's most famous public performance
Karenin's forgiveness: a forgiveness invoked from institution and doctrine, every sentence honest, every sentence detouring around the real motive—a textbook development of self-deception
Nekhlyudov's hunting chapter: action suspended and psychology dilated to the limit—the passage on which Chernyshevsky founded his 'dialectic of the soul'

Tolstoy's diaries (1847-1910, more than fifty years): second-order monitoring of his own vanity, lust, and hypocrisy at the same level he gives his characters—the method's experiment on its own author
modern_applications_zh: 心理治疗：在来访者报告情绪后立刻追问『你如何对待这份情绪』，把治疗从情绪层推进到处理层
谈判与审讯观察：训练识别对方语言中的自欺修辞（绕行的理由、过度的辩护），读出真实动机层
领导力复盘：要求管理者复盘决策时同时记录当时的情绪与对情绪的处理，建立元认知档案
写作与访谈：把采访问题从『你当时怎么想』升级为『你怎么看待你当时那么想』，直达二级层
modern_applications_en: Psychotherapy: after a client reports an emotion, immediately ask 'what do you do with this feeling,' advancing therapy from the emotion layer to the handling layer
Negotiation and interview observation: train the eye to catch self-deceiving rhetoric in the other side's language (detouring reasons, over-defense) and read the true motive layer
Leadership reviews: require managers, when reviewing decisions, to log both the emotion of the moment and how they handled it—building a metacognitive archive
Writing and interviewing: upgrade the question from 'what did you think then' to 'how do you regard having thought that then'—reaching the second-order layer directly

name_zh: 检验方法/把人放到悬崖边
name_en: 检验方法/把人放到悬崖边
category: 检验方法/把人放到悬崖边
modes.domain_zh: 要知道一个人（或一个思想、一个制度）的真实成色，不能看它在日常状态下的表现，而要看它在极限处境下的选择：把角色推到悬崖边——死亡、背叛、诱惑、羞辱的临界点——逼出日常道德语言掩盖不住的真实结构
modes.domain_en: To know the real quality of a person (or an idea, an institution), do not look at its everyday performance; look at its choices at the limit: push the character to the cliff's edge—the critical point of death, betrayal, temptation, humiliation—and force out the true structure that everyday moral language conceals
modes.definition_zh: 《伊凡·伊里奇之死》整部中篇就是一次极限实验的设计书：一个体面的法官，一生建立在『体面』之上，临终三个月里体面逐层剥落——同事惦记的是他的空缺、家人惦记的是繁琐、而他惦记的是：我的一生是否正确？托尔斯泰的做法不是争论『什么是有意义的人生』，而是直接把命题人物放进能最快溶解一切社会构造物的溶液——死亡——里观察什么留下了。方法论内核有三：其一，选择溶解液——不同的极限测试不同的结构：死亡溶解社会面具（留下真实信念），贫穷溶解修养（留下真实价值排序），权力溶解谦虚（留下真实欲望）；要测什么，就选对应的临界处境。其二，加速与对照——临终三个月是他给伊凡·伊里奇的时间压缩器：把一生的自欺压缩到几周内强制显影；同时设置对照组（年轻的格拉西姆，健康、坦然、不表演），让极限下两种人生答案同框。其三，读残余物——实验的产出不是被溶解的部分（体面、职位、社交），而是不被溶解的残余（对亲情的渴望、对光未来的恐惧）；残余物才是被试者的真材料。深意在于：日常状态下的道德判断几乎全是对舆论的反应，只有极限处境能区分『表演的道德』与『结构性的道德』——前者随环境蒸发，后者在悬崖边仍在运作。代价是：极限测试对被试者是残酷的（伊凡·伊里奇死于实验），且测试者自己必须先做过同类实验（托尔斯泰在《忏悔录》里对自己执行了同款死亡测试）。现代对应物是压力测试（金融、工程）、临终关怀研究、组织的危机演练与『火线提拔』的人才考察。
modes.definition_en: The Death of Ivan Ilyich is, entire, a design manual for the limit experiment: a respectable judge whose whole life was built on 'respectability,' stripped layer by layer through three dying months—his colleagues eye the vacancy, his family the inconvenience, while he asks: was my life right? Tolstoy does not argue 'what makes a meaningful life'; he drops the specimen straight into the solvent that dissolves social constructs fastest—death—and observes what remains. The method has three cores. First, choose the solvent: different limits test different structures—death dissolves the social mask (leaving true belief), poverty dissolves cultivation (leaving the true ranking of values), power dissolves modesty (leaving true desire); to test a thing, pick its corresponding critical condition. Second, acceleration with a control: the three dying months are his time-compressor, forcing a lifetime's self-deception to develop in weeks; and he sets a control (the young Gerasim—healthy, easy, unperformed) so that two answers to life stand in the same frame at the limit. Third, read the residue: the yield of the experiment is not what dissolved (respectability, office, society) but what would not dissolve (the craving for tenderness, the terror of no light ahead); the residue is the true material of the subject. The deeper point: everyday moral judgment is almost entirely reaction to opinion; only the limit-condition can separate performed morality from structural morality—the former evaporates with circumstance, the latter still operates at the cliff's edge. The cost: the test is cruel to its subject (Ivan Ilyich dies in the experiment), and the tester must first have run it on himself (Tolstoy performed the same death-test on himself in A Confession). Modern analogues: stress tests (finance, engineering), end-of-life care research, organizational crisis drills, and 'promote from the fire line' talent vetting.
modes.source_chapter: 《伊凡·伊里奇之死》（1886）；《忏悔录》（A Confession, 1882）开篇论『临死的聪明人不可能错过的问题』
modes.key_quote_zh: 体面在健康时无懈可击，在死亡面前一钱不值——要知道什么留得下来，先把它放进会溶解一切伪装的溶液里。
modes.key_quote_en: Respectability is unassailable in health and worthless before death—to know what remains, first put it into the solvent that dissolves every disguise.
process_zh: 确定要测的结构：明确想知道什么（信念？价值排序？忠诚？），为它选定对应的溶剂性处境（死亡/贫困/权力/诱惑）
设置时间压缩：不让测试在自然节奏里稀释，把被试者放进密度极大的临界期，迫使长期自欺短期显影
安排对照组：在同等极限下并置一个不同构造的参照（健康者/坦诚者/外行人），使被试者的反应获得可比较的坐标
判读残余物：记录被溶解的部分（面具、话术、习惯）与不被溶解的残余（欲望、恐惧、爱），以残余物而非言辞下结论
process_en: Fix the structure to be tested: state what you want to know (belief? value ranking? loyalty?) and choose the solvent-condition matching it (death, poverty, power, temptation)
Set time compression: do not let the test dilute at natural pace; put the subject in a high-density critical period that forces long-term self-deception to develop in short order
Place a control: set beside the subject, under the same limit, a differently-built reference (the healthy, the candid, the layman), giving the subject's reactions a comparable coordinate
Read the residue: record what dissolved (mask, rhetoric, habit) and what would not (desire, fear, love); conclude from the residue, not from the words
representative_cases_zh: 《伊凡·伊里奇之死》：社会性自我的逐层溶解全程记录——同事、妻子、女儿在死亡溶液里的不同残留，构成一幅『体面社会的水下照片』
《忏悔录》：托尔斯泰把同款测试施加于自己——功成名就之年追问『为什么不自杀』，把光环放进溶液只剩恐惧
《主与仆》（Master and Man）：暴风雪一夜把商人的算计与仆人的牺牲放进同一溶剂，残余物判读在一个夜晚完成
反例警示：一般颂扬文学的测试缺失——只在人物顺境里下道德判词，等于在无溶剂环境里宣称自己知道谁诚实
representative_cases_en: The Death of Ivan Ilyich: a complete record of a social self dissolving layer by layer—colleague, wife, daughter each leaving different residue in the solvent of death: an underwater photograph of respectable society
A Confession: Tolstoy ran the same test on himself—at the summit of fame asking 'why not suicide,' placing his own halo in solution and finding only terror left
Master and Man: one blizzard night puts the merchant's calculation and the servant's sacrifice into the same solvent; residue reading completed before dawn
Counter-case: panegyric literature's missing test—moral verdicts pronounced only in characters' good times amount to claiming, in a solvent-free environment, to know who is honest
modern_applications_zh: 人才评估：关键岗位晋升前设置高密度压力期（真实危机、真实取舍），以临场选择而非述职演讲判读
金融与工程：把机构/产品放进极端但可信的压力情景（挤兑、超载），读取哪些机制先失效
组织审计：危机是免费的极限测试——复盘时不要只记结果，要记录各部门在被溶解与残留两栏里各留下什么
自我检验：定期给个人生活做溶剂测试（想象临终/破产/失势），检查日常优先级里哪些是表演哪些是结构
modern_applications_en: Talent vetting: before promoting to critical roles, set a high-density stress period (real crisis, real trade-offs) and judge by in-situ choice, not the promotion speech
Finance and engineering: place institutions/products in extreme but credible stress scenarios (bank run, overload) and read which mechanisms fail first
Organizational audit: a crisis is a free limit test—review not only outcomes but what each unit left in the dissolved and the residue columns
Self-examination: periodically solvent-test one's own life (imagine dying, bankruptcy, downfall) and check which daily priorities are performance and which are structure

name_zh: 表达方法/撕掉自动化的标签
name_en: 表达方法/撕掉自动化的标签
category: 表达方法/撕掉自动化的标签
modes.domain_zh: 对付感知的自动化：人对最熟悉之物（室内的一棵树、一次鞠躬、一场歌剧）实际上视而不见，感知已被标签短路。方法是借用『第一次看见的眼睛』（动物、孩子、外乡人）重新扫描习以为常的世界，让被标签遮蔽的事物重新显形
modes.domain_en: Against the automatization of perception: people actually see nothing of the most familiar (a tree in a room, a bow, an opera)—perception has been short-circuited by the label. The method is to borrow 'the eyes of the first seeing' (an animal, a child, a stranger) and rescan the taken-for-granted world, making label-obscured things visible again
modes.definition_zh: 《安娜·卡列尼娜》第三部开头是文学史上最著名的一次感知重置：列文与吉提的爱情刚有眉目，头脑发热的他陪谢尔巴茨基家去看歌剧——从包厢望下去，他看到的不是歌剧而是一个『怪物场』：涂脂的、露胸的、爬梯子的生物在巨大空洞里表演奇怪仪式。托尔斯泰没有更换场景，只更换了眼睛：用列文这个对上流社会仪式『不识货』的乡下人，把千人看惯的剧场还原成它本来的怪诞。方法论内核有三：其一，识别自动化标签——每个领域都有一套让成员停止观看的编码（礼仪、行话、审美惯例），它们是效率工具也是盲区制造机；要先列出『此处大家都假装看见了什么』。其二，安装外置复眼——借助天然的外来者（动物：霍尔斯托梅尔眼中的马世；孩子：儿童眼中成人礼仪的荒谬；外乡人）获得不需要练习的陌生视点，或者自己实施『降级观看』（假装第一次看见）。其三，拒绝 Comedy 也不升级成嘲讽——陌生化的目的不是笑话而是重新看见：歌剧场景收束于列文的羞怯与『他其实渴望被接纳』，怪诞与渴望并置才是完整感知。深意在于：感知的敌人不是无知而是熟练——专家的盲区比外行更大，因为他连『自己在不看见』都不知道；任何需要长期浸泡的领域都要周期性地请一双外来眼睛。代价是：陌生化会让共同体不适（这是对共同体的隐形批判），且外置眼睛可能只看见表层怪诞而漏掉编码内的精细功能。现代对应物是什克洛夫斯基的『陌生化』诗学（直接师承托尔斯泰）、人类学的参与观察、以及产品设计的『新手视角走查』。
modes.definition_en: Part Three of Anna Karenina opens with the most famous perceptual reset in literary history: with his love for Kitty stirring, the over-excited Levin accompanies the Shcherbatskys to the opera—and from the box he sees not an opera but a 'monsters' theater': painted, bare-shouldered creatures on ladders performing strange rites in a vast hollow. Tolstoy changes nothing about the scene and everything about the eyes: using Levin, the countryman who 'doesn't know the goods' of polite ritual, he restores the thousand-times-seen theater to its native grotesque. The method has three cores. First, identify the automation labels: every field has a code that stops its members from seeing (etiquette, jargon, aesthetic convention)—efficient tools and blindness-machines at once; begin by listing 'what everyone here pretends to see.' Second, install external compound eyes: borrow a natural outsider (the animal: horse-world in Holstomer's eyes; the child: adult ritual grown absurd; the stranger) for a viewpoint requiring no practice, or run 'downgraded seeing' yourself (pretend to see it for the first time). Third, neither comedic nor contemptuous: defamiliarization aims not at jokes but at re-seeing; the opera scene closes on Levin's shyness and his wish to be admitted—grotesque and longing juxtaposed is complete perception. The deeper point: perception's enemy is not ignorance but fluency—the expert's blind spot is larger than the layman's, for he does not even know he is not seeing; any long-steeped field must periodically borrow a pair of outside eyes. The cost: defamiliarization discomforts the community (it is an implicit critique of it), and the outside eye may catch surface grotesque while missing the fine functions inside the code. Modern analogues: Shklovsky's poetics of estrangement (direct heir to Tolstoy), anthropological participant observation, and the novice-perspective walkthrough in product design.
modes.source_chapter: 《安娜·卡列尼娜》第三部第二章（列文看歌剧）；《霍尔斯托梅尔》（马的叙事）序言论自动化感知
modes.key_quote_zh: 看惯的眼睛是最大的失明：请一匹马、一个孩子、一个乡下来的人替你重新看一遍你每天都看的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: The eye grown used to seeing is the deepest blindness: borrow a horse, a child, a man from the countryside to look again at what you look at every day.
process_zh: 列出自动化清单：写下本领域内『人人假装看见/听见/理解』的编码性事物（仪式、术语、惯例、品味），标出最自动化的三处
选装外置复眼：为每一处找一个天然外来者视角（外行、儿童、异文化、甚至动物）或执行降级观看（抹掉自己全部先验重新进入）
完整重扫并记差异：用外来眼睛重走一遍流程，逐项记录『看见的怪诞/冗余/美』，与内部编码对照
带回并裁决：区分真冗余（可删）与表观怪诞（编码内有功能）；把确认为盲区的部分提交共同体，承受不适
process_en: List the automations: write down the coded things 'everyone here pretends to see, hear, or understand' (rituals, terms, conventions, tastes); mark the three most automatized
Fit the external eye: for each, find a natural outsider's view (layman, child, foreign culture, even an animal) or run downgraded seeing (erase your own priors and re-enter)
Rescan fully and log differences: walk the whole flow again with the outside eyes, item by item logging 'grotesque, redundancy, beauty seen,' checked against the inside code
Carry back and adjudicate: separate true redundancy (deletable) from apparent grotesque (functional within the code); submit the confirmed blind spots to the community and bear the discomfort
representative_cases_zh: 列文看歌剧：一整段『降级观看』——观众席与舞台的仪式被还原成怪诞的人体展览，而下文立刻补上他对被接纳的渴望，批判与渴望同框
《霍尔斯托梅尔》：以老马的眼睛看人类对马的所有权辩论——动物复眼让『私有财产』这个自动化概念当场陌生化
《论艺术》对瓦格纳与『艺术行话』的清算：以『普通人看不看得懂』为外置眼睛，撕掉当时艺术共同体的自动化标签
反例警示：熟练的评论家群体对同一仪式互相印证『好在哪里』——自动化标签的集体维护，谁也看不见谁在失明
representative_cases_en: Levin at the opera: a full passage of downgraded seeing—auditorium and stage ritual restored to a grotesque exhibition of bodies, immediately answered by his longing to be admitted, critique and longing in one frame
Holstomer: ownership of horses debated through an old horse's eyes—the animal's compound eye estranges 'private property' on the spot
What Is Art?'s settling of accounts with Wagner and artistic jargon: using 'can an ordinary person understand it' as the external eye, tearing off the artistic community's automation labels
Counter-case: the circle of fluent critics mutually confirming 'what is good' about the same ritual—collective maintenance of the automation label, none seeing that all are blind
modern_applications_zh: 产品与体验设计：每季度执行『新手视角走查』——由从未使用过的人走完全流程，逐屏记录怪诞与困惑
组织流程审计：对『历来如此』的会议、报表、审批，请外部门或新员工降级观看一遍，标记真冗余
学术自检：在自己学科内部培养『外行提问』习惯——用圈外常识追问本领域自动化术语背后的实际所指
日常感知训练：对最熟悉的空间与关系定期『第一次看见』重扫，防止亲密与熟练导致的感知失明
modern_applications_en: Product and experience design: run a quarterly novice-perspective walkthrough—someone who has never used it walks the whole flow, logging grotesque and confusion screen by screen
Organizational process audit: for the meetings, reports, and approvals 'that have always been so,' have another department or a new hire downgrade-watch once and mark true redundancy
Academic self-check: cultivate the habit of the 'layman's question' inside one's own discipline—press coded terms with common sense from outside the circle
Everyday perceptual training: periodically rescan the most familiar spaces and relationships as if seeing them first, preventing the blindness of intimacy and fluency

name_zh: 批判方法/审美判断的伦理还原
name_en: 批判方法/审美判断的伦理还原
category: 批判方法/审美判断的伦理还原
modes.domain_zh: 拒绝把审美判断与道德判断分开结算：一部作品的感染力不是它价值的证明，反而可能是它危险的证据——『它让我流泪』与『它把我变好还是变坏』是两个必须同时回答的问题。艺术评估的最终法庭不是趣味共同体，而是它对人心产生的实际后果
modes.domain_en: Refusing to settle aesthetic and moral judgment in separate accounts: a work's infectious power is no proof of its value and may be evidence of its danger—'it moved me to tears' and 'did it make people better or worse' are two questions that must be answered together. The final court of art assessment is not the community of taste but the work's actual effect on human hearts
modes.definition_zh: 《什么是艺术？》（1897）是托尔斯泰与自己的过去打的一场清算战争：这部书否定他自己的《战争与和平》级别的一切『为艺术而艺术』，理由只有一个——感染的真伪不由精致程度决定，而由它传递的是把人分开还是把人连起来的情感决定。方法论内核有三：其一，双重记账——任何作品同时记两笔账：感染力（它能否抓住人）与感染方向（抓住人之后把人心推向何处）；只记第一笔的批评是危险的批评。其二，以最简为真——真艺术的检验标准之一是清晰：连不上普通人的『精英感染』被列为可疑，因为复杂化常常是虚伪的掩体（专业化行话、精致的形式都是把普通人挡在外的门闩）。其三，自反执行——这项标准他首先施加于自己：晚年他把《忏悔录》《伊凡·伊里奇之死》《主与仆》写作简到近乎裸（短句、直陈、无装饰），因为他认定这些晚期作品感染方向为善。深意在于：一切强大的表达工具都自带伦理维度，评估表达时绕开后果问题等于给武器免检。代价是：道德法庭极易被自己的道德偏狭劫持（他晚年否定莎士比亚与贝多芬晚期作品的判决多数同行不接受），且把感染力与道德绑审会惩罚那些道德复杂、拒绝说教的第一流作品。现代对应物是媒体的『效果研究』传统、内容平台的伦理审计与算法推荐的价值审查。
modes.definition_en: What Is Art? (1897) is the war Tolstoy waged in settlement with his own past: the book repudiates everything of the 'art for art's sake' kind—including his own War and Peace—on one ground alone: the truth of infectiousness is decided not by refinement but by whether what is conveyed divides people or joins them. The method has three cores. First, double-entry bookkeeping: any work is entered on two ledgers at once—force (can it seize people) and direction (having seized them, where does it push their hearts); criticism that keeps only the first ledger is dangerous criticism. Second, simplicity as the mark of the true: one test of genuine art is clarity—'elite infection' that cannot reach ordinary people is suspect, for complication is often hypocrisy's bunker (professional jargon, exquisite form: bolts keeping the common man out). Third, reflexive enforcement: he applied the standard to himself first—late in life he wrote A Confession, The Death of Ivan Ilyich, and Master and Man in a bareness bordering on nakedness (short sentences, direct statement, no ornament), because he judged those late works' direction of infection good. The deeper point: every powerful instrument of expression carries an ethical dimension; to assess expression while bypassing the question of consequence is to give weapons a duty-free pass. The cost: a moral court is easily hijacked by its own moral narrowness (his late verdicts against Shakespeare and late Beethoven few peers accepted), and binding infectiousness to morality punishes first-rank works whose morality is complex and anti-didactic. Modern analogues: the media-effects tradition, ethical audit of content platforms, and value review of recommender systems.
modes.source_chapter: 《什么是艺术？》（Что такое искусство?，1897）第十一至十五章论感染力与善恶
modes.key_quote_zh: 一件作品让我流泪，只证明它有力，不证明它良善；同时问两句——它抓住我，又把我推向哪里。
modes.key_quote_en: That a work moved me to tears proves only its power, not its goodness; ask both questions at once—it seized me, and where did it push me?
process_zh: 分立两本账：对任何作品/表达先分别记录感染力（能否抓住人、抓住多少）与感染方向（抓住之后对人的心做了什么），禁止用第一本抵扣第二本
做清晰性检验：检查作品能否被其意图影响的最普通人接收；连不上的部分要追问是深度还是掩体
执行自反测试：把同一套标准先施加于自己的产出（自己最得意、最精致的东西），观察是否通过
承受并公布判决：即便结论否定自己过去或共同体共识，也要完整公布判断与理由，接受历史复核
process_en: Keep two ledgers apart: for any work or expression, record separately its force (can it seize, how many) and its direction (what it does to hearts once seized); never let the first offset the second
Run the clarity test: check whether the work reaches the most ordinary person it claims to move; where it does not connect, ask whether the cause is depth or bunker
Enforce reflexive testing: apply the same standard first to one's own output (one's proudest, most exquisite work) and observe whether it passes
Bear and publish the verdict: even where it repudiates one's own past or the community's consensus, publish judgment and reasons in full and accept history's re-review
representative_cases_zh: 《什么是艺术？》：对莎士比亚、瓦格纳与自己全部早期小说的双重记账审判——感染力最高的一批作品被判感染方向可疑，惊动整个欧洲批评界
晚年文体转向：《忏悔录》《伊凡·伊里奇之死》《主与仆》句法直裸如民间故事——把双重记账的判决执行到自己的笔上
对民间故事与感恩派圣歌的推崇：检验标准倒置后，此前不入眼的『底层艺术』升为最高级——共同体趣味的坐标系被整体重置
反例警示：只做单向记账的当代流量批评（『数据好就是好』）——感染力账本单独结算，方向账本完全空置
representative_cases_en: What Is Art?: double-entry judgment passed on Shakespeare, Wagner, and all his own early novels—the most infectious works of the age ruled suspect in direction, convulsing European criticism
The late stylistic turn: A Confession, The Death of Ivan Ilyich, Master and Man in syntax bare as folk tale—the verdict of double-entry bookkeeping executed upon his own pen
The elevation of folk tales and sectarian hymns: once the test is inverted, previously invisible 'low art' ranks highest—the coordinate system of communal taste reset wholesale
Counter-case: today's single-ledger traffic criticism ('the numbers are good, so it is good')—the force ledger settled alone, the direction ledger left entirely blank
modern_applications_zh: 内容平台治理：对爆款内容同时审计感染力与感染方向（它放大的是连接还是仇恨、是理解还是成瘾），双向指标写入推荐系统
广告与营销审查：任何营销战役立项时同时承诺效果指标与伦理红线，禁止只用转化率结算
文艺批评职业规范：批评文章必须同时回答『好不好看』与『对读者做了什么』，拒绝纯趣味共同体结算
个人媒介素养：对自己沉迷的每一类内容自问感染方向——它把我变成更想要连接还是更想要刺激的人
modern_applications_en: Content-platform governance: audit viral content on both force and direction (connection or hatred, understanding or addiction), writing both metrics into recommender systems
Advertising and marketing review: every campaign commits at launch to both performance metrics and ethical red lines; settlement by conversion rate alone is barred
Professional norms of criticism: a critical essay must answer both 'is it gripping' and 'what does it do to readers,' refusing settlement within the taste community alone
Personal media literacy: for every category of content one binges, ask its direction of infection—does it make me a person who wants connection or one who wants stimulation

name_zh: 行动方法/从特权内部拆特权
name_en: 行动方法/从特权内部拆特权
category: 行动方法/从特权内部拆特权
modes.domain_zh: 确认自己处在不义结构的受益端之后，不在结构外呐喊，而在结构内做可核验的让步实验：释放农奴、放弃财产、亲自耕种——用自己可以支配的部分先兑换成真补偿，把『我认为不对』变成『我已让出』
modes.domain_en: Having established that one sits on the benefiting end of an unjust structure, do not shout from outside the structure; run verifiable concession experiments inside it: free the serfs, give up property, plow with one's own hands—converting the portion one controls into real compensation first, turning 'I think this is wrong' into 'I have already given it up'
modes.definition_zh: 1856 年他向雅斯纳亚·波良纳周围村庄提出解放农奴的方案——不是因为理论说服了他，而是克里米亚战场上他亲眼看过普通农民士兵如何赴死：『这些人替我冒险，而我从他们的劳动里受益』。此后四十年，他的每一步都是让步实验的延续：解放农奴（附土地条件的失败版本与失败记录都留下）、办农民子弟学校、分掉版税与地产（1910 年离家出走前已完成资产转移安排）、最后一封家书仍在处理『我死后版权归属公众』。方法论内核有三：其一，受益端自认——先完成对自己位置的审计：我在这个结构里占谁的便宜？这是让步实验与一般善行的分水岭：善行可以来自任何位置，让步实验只能来自受益端。其二，可核验性优先——让步不诉诸动机而诉诸凭据：契约、学校账本、财产过户、版权文件，全部留下可查记录；他知道道德表态的通胀率极高，唯一防通胀的是文件。其三，实验迭代——第一次解放农奴失败（农民不信地主会白给），他不宣布理想破产而是改进设计（办学、直接分配、最终离家出走把自己变成最后一个让步项）。深意在于：从不义结构里脱身的真实路径不在结构外的完美批判，而在结构内的让步序列——每一项让步都真实，序列就有可能走到终点。代价是：让步实验的终点与家庭、法律、共同体全面冲突（八十岁离家出走死在小车站），且单点让步可能被结构重新吸收（解放农奴后地主仍握有土地与话语）。现代对应物是慈善家的『有效捐赠』审计、企业主的利润上限承诺与个人碳账户式的自我补偿核算。
modes.definition_en: In 1856 he proposed a scheme to free the serfs of the villages around Yasnaya Polyana—not because theory had convinced him, but because at Sevastopol he had watched ordinary peasant soldiers go to their deaths: 'these men risked themselves for me, and I profited from their labor.' For forty years after, every step was a continuation of the concession experiment: freeing the serfs (leaving records of both the land-conditional version and its failure), founding schools for peasant children, giving away royalties and estates (arrangements for transferring assets were complete before his flight in 1910), his last family letter still settling 'the copyright going to the public after my death.' The method has three cores. First, self-audit from the benefiting end: begin by auditing one's own position—whose advantage do I take in this structure? This is the watershed between concession experiments and ordinary good deeds: good deeds can come from any position, concessions only from the benefiting end. Second, verifiability first: concessions appeal not to motive but to documents—contracts, school ledgers, deeds of transfer, copyright papers, all on record; he knew the inflation rate of moral pronouncements, and the only anti-inflation device is paper. Third, experimental iteration: the first emancipation failed (the peasants could not believe a landlord would give freely); he did not declare the ideal bankrupt but redesigned—schools, direct distribution, and at last walking out of home, making himself the final concession item. The deeper point: the real path out of an unjust structure lies not in perfect critique from outside but in a sequence of concessions within it—each concession real, the sequence can walk to its end. The cost: the sequence's terminus collides with family, law, and community all at once (he died at a small railway station at eighty-two), and a single concession can be reabsorbed by the structure (after emancipation the landlord still held the land and the word). Modern analogues: philanthropists' effective-giving audits, owners' profit-cap pledges, and personal carbon-account self-compensation.
modes.source_chapter: 1856 年雅斯纳亚·波良纳解放农奴方案；《忏悔录》（1882）第二章塞瓦斯托波尔经验；1910 年离家出走与遗嘱安排
modes.key_quote_zh: 我从这些人的劳动里活到今天——辩论不能偿还，文件可以：把能给的先给出去，把契约放在谈感想之前。
modes.key_quote_en: I have lived to this day on these men's labor—debate cannot repay, but documents can: give away what can be given, and put the contract before the reflections.
process_zh: 审计自身位置：列出自己从当前结构中获得的每一项收益（收入、便利、话语权），确认自己在受益端而非旁观席
选定可让步资产：在可支配范围内找出真实可让的东西（财产、版权、时间、位置），排除表演性牺牲
凭据化执行：每次让步都落到可核验的文件与记录上，公开账目，不依赖口头动机声明
迭代与推进：实验失败时区分『方案失败』与『方向破产』，改进设计进入下一轮，直到可让部分让完
process_en: Audit one's own position: list every benefit drawn from the current structure (income, convenience, voice) and confirm one sits at the benefiting end, not the gallery
Choose concretely concedable assets: within what one controls, find the genuinely concedable (property, copyright, time, position), excluding performative sacrifice
Execute with documents: land every concession in verifiable records and open accounts, relying on no spoken declarations of motive
Iterate and advance: when an experiment fails, distinguish 'scheme failed' from 'direction bankrupt'; improve the design and run the next round until the concedable is fully conceded
representative_cases_zh: 1856 年解放农奴方案：附土地与赎买条款的第一次实验——农民不信而失败，但失败记录本身成为下一次设计的输入
雅斯纳亚·波良纳学校：给农民子弟免费教育并自任教师——让步从地契扩展到时间与知识
版权与地产的遗嘱安排：1890 年代起逐步把早期作品版权捐入公众领域、财产分配写入遗嘱——把身后也纳入让步序列
反例警示：同期沙龙里的农奴制辩论——语言上的反农奴制与生活上的继续受益并存，正是没有凭据化与自认环节的对照标本
representative_cases_en: The 1856 emancipation scheme: a first experiment with land and redemption clauses—failed through peasant distrust, the failure itself becoming input to the next design
The Yasnaya Polyana school: free education for peasant children with himself as teacher—concession extended from deeds to time and knowledge
The wills over copyright and estates: from the 1890s, early copyrights given to the public domain and property distribution written into his will—folding the after-death into the concession sequence
Counter-case: the salon debates on serfdom of his day—verbal anti-serfdom coexisting with continued benefit, the very specimen lacking self-audit and documentation
modern_applications_zh: 企业与平台治理：处于结构性优势的企业先做可核验让步（数据开放、抽成上限、审计权），把价值观写成合同条款
个人伦理核算：定期审计自己在全球不平等结构中的位置，以可验证的方式（捐赠上限、用工、消费）执行让步序列
代际与家庭公平：继承规划中把『承认结构性不义』落实为可核验的分配安排，而非口头道歉
学术与职业伦理：从优势机构让渡资源（开放数据、公开同行评审记录），使平等主张有凭据
modern_applications_en: Corporate and platform governance: firms at structural advantage make verifiable concessions first (data openness, take-rate caps, audit rights), writing values into contract clauses
Personal ethical accounting: periodically audit one's position in global inequality and run a concession sequence in verifiable form (giving caps, labor practices, consumption)
Intergenerational and family fairness: implement recognition of structural injustice in inheritance planning as verifiable distribution, not spoken apology
Academic and professional ethics: advantaged institutions concede resources (open data, public peer-review records) so that equality claims carry documents

name_zh: 行动方法/以受苦为论据
name_en: 行动方法/以受苦为论据
category: 行动方法/以受苦为论据
modes.domain_zh: 面对强力时不组织对等的暴力，而是拒绝合作并公开承受代价：把身体放进对方的强制机器里，让机器每压一次都要在众目睽睽下暴露一次自己的不义——受苦本身成为论证，承受者成为证人
modes.domain_en: Facing superior force, do not organize a matching violence; refuse cooperation and bear the cost openly: put the body inside the other's coercive machine so that every squeeze exposes the machine's injustice once more before all eyes—suffering itself becomes the argument, the sufferer the witness
modes.definition_zh: 《天国在你心中》（1894）是二十世纪非暴力行动的理论前身：托尔斯泰逐条拆掉『以暴制暴』的论证（暴力只能繁殖暴力，且每一个拿枪的人首先杀掉的是自己的道德坐标），然后给出替代程序——不服从但也不反抗：拒绝服兵役、拒绝纳税、拒绝起誓，同时平静接受监禁与没收。方法论内核有三：其一，把代价资产化——不服从的成本（坐牢、失业、家产）不被回避而被最大化利用：公开、平静、可预期的受苦向旁观者持续传输『这个制度需要靠伤害人才能维持』的证据链。其二，证词的纯净性要求——承受者必须避免仇恨与自我戏剧化，因为一旦掺杂怨恨，证据就从『制度不义』滑向『私人恩怨』；甘地从托尔斯泰那里继承的第一课正是这种纪律（1909-1910 两人通信）。其三，人数的复利——单人不服从只是殉道，成千上万人的平静不服从构成政权无法定价的成本曲线；托尔斯泰未及见到组织化版本，但甘地与马丁·路德·金把它做成了行动科学。深意在于：暴力的对决只在力量维度上较量，非暴力把战场转移到合法性维度——政权最强的武力恰恰是它最贵的软肋。代价是：这条路径要求承受者有异常的心理与物质储备，且对彻底不在乎合法性（不怕丑闻）的政权近乎无效。现代对应物是甘地的 satyagraha、公民不服从的公民权运动、以及现代和平抗议的组织纪律。
modes.definition_en: The Kingdom of God Is Within You (1894) is the theoretical ancestor of twentieth-century nonviolent action: Tolstoy dismantles, clause by clause, the case for countering violence with violence (violence breeds only violence, and every man who takes up the gun first kills his own moral coordinates), then gives the alternative procedure—disobey, yet do not resist: refuse military service, refuse taxes, refuse oaths, while calmly accepting prison and confiscation. The method has three cores. First, capitalize the cost: the price of disobedience (prison, unemployment, property) is not avoided but maximally used—open, calm, predictable suffering continuously transmits to onlookers the evidence chain 'this regime needs to hurt people to keep running.' Second, the purity requirement of testimony: the bearer must avoid hatred and self-dramatization, for once resentment mixes in, the evidence slides from 'institutional injustice' to 'private grudge'; the first lesson Gandhi inherited from Tolstoy (their correspondence of 1909-1910) was exactly this discipline. Third, the compound interest of numbers: one person's refusal is mere martyrdom; the calm refusal of thousands builds a cost curve no regime can price. Tolstoy did not live to see the organized version, but Gandhi and Martin Luther King made it an action science. The deeper point: violent confrontation contests only the dimension of strength; nonviolence moves the battlefield to the dimension of legitimacy—a regime's strongest weapon is its most expensive vulnerability. The cost: the path demands unusual psychological and material reserves, and against a regime indifferent to legitimacy (unafraid of scandal) it is nearly void. Modern analogues: Gandhi's satyagraha, the civil-rights practice of civil disobedience, and the organizational discipline of modern peaceful protest.
modes.source_chapter: 《天国在你心中》（Царство Божие внутри вас，1894）；与甘地通信（1909-1910）；《复活》中聂赫留朵夫拒绝陪审伪程序
modes.key_quote_zh: 不要用他们的武器还击——把身体交给他们的机器，让每一次镇压都替你完成一次公开论证。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not return their weapons—give your body to their machine, and let every act of repression complete another public argument for you.
process_zh: 选定不合作清单：列出自己实际参与的不义机器（兵役、税款、伪程序、消费），逐项确定可拒绝的节点
预设代价并公示：事先公开将承受的后果（监禁、失业、损失），把代价从威胁转化为预期中的证词
保持证词纯净：执行全程禁止仇恨表达与表演性悲情，只呈现事实与承受，让不义由对方行为完成举证
扩大平静复利：把方法程序化、可复制化（训练、手册、社群），使单人殉道成长为难以定价的集体成本曲线
process_en: Choose the noncooperation list: itemize the unjust machines one actually joins (service, taxes, pseudo-procedure, consumption) and fix the nodes that can be refused
Predeclare the cost: announce the consequences to be borne (prison, job loss, forfeiture), converting the threat into testimony already expected
Keep the testimony pure: throughout, forbid expressions of hatred and performative pathos; present only facts and endurance, letting the other side's acts supply the proof of injustice
Compound the calm: proceduralize and replicate the method (training, handbooks, communities) so single martyrdom grows into a collective cost curve no one can price
representative_cases_zh: 《天国在你心中》：从教义到兵役清单的完整程序设计——各国青年拒服兵役者把它当作行动手册使用
托尔斯泰-甘地通信（1909-1910）：《印度自治》的道德内核经此确认——非暴力从思想变成有纪律的方法论
《复活》的结尾设计：聂赫留朵夫放弃土地、追随流放——文学人物完成了让步与不服从的合并示范
反例警示：同时期各种密谋暴动小组的结局——以暴对暴的力量对决里，组织者在力量维度上永远吃亏，且提前交出了道德证据
representative_cases_en: The Kingdom of God Is Within You: a complete program from doctrine to a checklist of refusal—conscientious objectors across countries used it as an action manual
The Tolstoy-Gandhi correspondence (1909-1910): the moral core of Hind Swaraj confirmed through it—nonviolence turned from idea into disciplined method
The design of Resurrection's ending: Nekhlyudov gives up his land and follows the exile—a literary character completing the combined demonstration of concession and noncooperation

Counter-case: the fate of conspiratorial insurrection cells of the same era—in the strength-dimension duel of violence against violence, organizers always lose on force and surrender the moral evidence in advance
modern_applications_zh: 公民行动设计：把抗议从『情绪宣泄』升级为『成本曲线工程』——纪律、可预期受苦与证词纯净性写入行动守则
劳资谈判：罢工组织者预先公示损失与诉求、严禁暴力，把资方镇压转化为公众可见的不义证据
国际压力策略：制裁与不合作政策设计需评估对方政权对合法性的敏感度，对不敏感者更换路径
组织内异议：以公开、平静、留档的方式拒绝不当指令并接受处分，把个人代价转化为组织治理证据
modern_applications_en: Civic action design: upgrade protest from emotional venting to cost-curve engineering—discipline, predictable suffering, and testimony purity written into the action code
Labor negotiation: strike organizers preannounce losses and demands, ban violence outright, and turn employer crackdowns into injustice evidence visible to the public
International pressure strategy: sanctions and noncooperation design must gauge the target regime's sensitivity to legitimacy; switch paths for the insensitive
Dissent inside organizations: refuse improper directives openly, calmly, and on record while accepting sanctions, converting personal cost into governance evidence

name_zh: 表达方法/以最少的词承载最大的真
name_en: 表达方法/以最少的词承载最大的真
category: 表达方法/以最少的词承载最大的真
modes.domain_zh: 把『清晰可达』设为表达的硬约束：句子短、词是活的民间语汇、装饰性修辞一律裁撤——衡量标准是『最普通的读者能否在第一遍读到全部』。繁复不是深度，是深度还没有被消化时留下的渣
modes.domain_en: Set 'clarity and reach' as the hard constraint of expression: short sentences, living folk vocabulary, all ornamental rhetoric pruned—measured by whether the most ordinary reader gets everything on first reading. Complication is not depth; it is the dregs left when depth has not yet been digested
modes.definition_zh: 托尔斯泰晚年的文体转向是一条可测绘的曲线：从《战争与和平》的法语混编长句，到《伊凡·伊里奇之死》的短促直陈（开篇：『伊万·伊里奇的一生岁月是最简单、最平常、因而也是最可怕的』），再到民间故事《人靠什么活着》——句法上脱尽文人腔。他给这条曲线写下过理论说明（《什么是艺术？》论普遍可达性），更留下工具记录：他改稿的草稿堆里，删掉的几乎全是形容词与从句；他对农民听众朗读并据反应删改。方法论内核有三：其一，复杂度预算——每次表达都有有限的复杂度额度，必须花在命题本身的复杂上，而不是花在句法与辞藻的复杂上；额度用尽的信号是普通读者开始跳读。其二，民间语汇优先——用说给不识字的人也能懂的话写作，不是降格而是最高检验：凡是民间语汇装不下的精确，多半是思想本身还没长好。其三，朗读测试——用耳朵当质检：读不出口的长句就是负担读者记忆的违章建筑，一律拆。深意在于：简不是风格的谦逊，是认识的诚实——能说简单话而说复杂话的人，常在用复杂掩护没想清楚；同时简是对听众的平等承诺（知识不该因文体而变成门票）。代价是：简一律会压缩思想的灰度（他晚期作品常被批评为寓言化），且对天生繁复的题材（如《战争与和平》的全景）不适用。现代对应物是 Plain Language 运动、费曼技巧与新闻倒金字塔的结构纪律。
modes.definition_en: Tolstoy's late stylistic turn is a measurable curve: from the French-larded long sentences of War and Peace to the short directness of The Death of Ivan Ilyich (opening: 'Ivan Ilyich's life had been most simple and most ordinary and therefore most terrible'), to the folk tale What Men Live By—syntax stripped of literary manner altogether. He left a theoretical note on the curve (the universal-reachability argument in What Is Art?) and a tool record: in the drafts, what is deleted is almost always adjectives and subordinate clauses; he read aloud to peasants and cut by their response. The method has three cores. First, a complexity budget: every act of expression has a finite complexity allowance, and it must be spent on the complexity of the proposition, not on complex syntax and diction; the signal of an exhausted budget is when ordinary readers start to skim. Second, folk vocabulary first: writing in words intelligible to the illiterate is not condescension but the highest test—whatever precision the folk vocabulary cannot hold is mostly thought that has not yet grown straight. Third, the read-aloud test: use the ear as quality control; a long sentence that cannot be spoken is an illegal building burdening the reader's memory—to be demolished. The deeper point: simplicity is not stylistic modesty but epistemic honesty—those who can speak simply yet choose the complex are often using complexity to screen muddle; and simplicity is a promise of equality to the audience (knowledge must not become a ticket because of style). The cost: the law of simplicity compresses the gray of thought (his late work is often faulted as parable-like), and it does not suit natively sprawling subjects (the panorama of War and Peace). Modern analogues: the Plain Language movement, the Feynman technique, and the structural discipline of the news inverted pyramid.
modes.source_chapter: 《伊凡·伊里奇之死》开篇句；《什么是艺术？》论普遍可达性；民间故事《人靠什么活着》（Чем люди живы，1885）
modes.key_quote_zh: 伊万·伊里奇的一生是最简单、最平常、因而也是最可怕的——让最普通的读者第一遍就得到全部。
modes.key_quote_en: Ivan Ilyich's life had been most simple and most ordinary and therefore most terrible—let the most ordinary reader get all of it on the first pass.
process_zh: 分配复杂度预算：先判定命题本身的复杂点在哪，把全部复杂度额度花在那里，句法与辞藻一律从简
民间语汇改写：把成稿里的行话、术语、外来腔换成活语言；换不进去的地方标记出来——那是思想还没长好的位置
朗读拆楼：通读全文出声，凡是读不出口的长句一律拆短；删形容词优先于删名词
普通读者测试：交给目标受众里最不专业的一位，记录第一遍漏掉的点，逐点回改
process_en: Allocate the complexity budget: decide where the proposition's true complexity lies and spend the whole allowance there; syntax and diction kept plain throughout
Rewrite in folk vocabulary: replace jargon, terminology, and borrowed accents with living language; mark every spot that will not convert—that is where the thought has not grown straight
Read aloud and demolish: read the whole aloud; every sentence that cannot be spoken is broken shorter; adjectives cut before nouns
Ordinary-reader test: give it to the least expert member of the intended audience, log what is missed on first reading, and revise point by point
representative_cases_zh: 《伊凡·伊里奇之死》开篇句：全篇的审判在一句平白话里完成——简单与可怕的并置是句法极简的极限案例
民间故事改写工程：1880 年代把寓言重写为识字课本级别的语言并自费出版——《人靠什么活着》成为全球流传最广的托尔斯泰文本
《什么是艺术？》的自我引用：用最不体面的直白攻击最高级的艺术建制——论证的火力与句法的简陋同向
反例警示：他早年贵族沙龙腔（含法语句式）——同一个头脑的两套文体，证明简不是能力而是选择与纪律
representative_cases_en: The opening sentence of The Death of Ivan Ilyich: the whole work's verdict delivered in one plain sentence—juxtaposing the simple and the terrible at the extreme of syntactic minimalism
The folk-tale rewriting project: in the 1880s parables rewritten at primer-level language and self-published—What Men Live By became the most widely circulated Tolstoy text in the world
The self-citation in What Is Art?: the bluntest prose attacking the most refined art establishment—the argument's firepower and the syntax's plainness pointing the same way
Counter-case: his early salon style with its French clauses—two styles from one mind, proving simplicity is not ability but choice and discipline
modern_applications_zh: 技术写作：API 文档、法律条款、知情同意书按复杂度预算重写——复杂只允许留在概念本身
公众科学传播：费曼式检验——能用朴素语言讲清的才算真懂，讲不清的回去重学
政策与公告发布：普通读者第一遍测试（记录漏读点）作为发布前置条件
组织沟通规范：管理层书面沟通禁用内部行话，新员工听不懂即返工
modern_applications_en: Technical writing: API docs, legal terms, and consent forms rewritten under a complexity budget—complexity allowed only in the concept itself
Public science communication: the Feynman test—only what can be said plainly is truly understood; the rest goes back for restudy
Policy and announcements: an ordinary-reader first-pass test (logging missed points) as a precondition of publication
Organizational communication norms: management writing banned from internal jargon; rework if a new hire cannot follow

name_zh: 本体方法/以死为尺的人生结算
name_en: 本体方法/以死为尺的人生结算
category: 本体方法/以死为尺的人生结算
modes.domain_zh: 把死亡设为人生账目的唯一审计标准：定期以『临终之眼』回看自己的每一天与每项持有——凡在死亡视角下贬值的资产（名声、体面、积累）重新定价，凡升值的资产（关系、当下、给予）加仓。结算必须落在行动：转让、出走、改写日程
modes.domain_en: Set death as the sole audit standard of life's accounts: periodically look back at every day and every holding with 'deathbed eyes'—repricing assets that depreciate under death's view (fame, respectability, accumulation) and adding to those that appreciate (relations, the present, giving). The settlement must land in action: transfer, departure, rewritten schedules
modes.definition_zh: 1881 年的转折是这场审计最彻底的一次执行：四十八岁、欧洲最著名的在世作家，他把全家从莫斯科的体面宅邸迁入农夫公寓，宣布艺术、财产、家族荣誉在他的死亡视角下全部贬值。此前《忏悔录》已给出审计底稿：『我的问题不是如何生活，而是我的生活有什么意义——如果终点是死，一切积累都是向零的转账。』此后三十年，他持续执行临终清算法：日记逐日复核虚荣与自欺、财产逐步转出、81 岁离家出走把自己彻底变成流亡者（死在阿斯塔波沃小站）。方法论内核有三：其一，设死为尺——不是修辞而是程序：任何一项持有（职位、房产、名声、纠纷）都要回答『卧床最后一天时它值多少』，答不出的即列入清算表。其二，贬值资产先转让——清算不是弃绝而是转让：财产给需要的人、版权给公众、时间给当下的人；转让对象本身就是重新定价的证据。其三，行动终审——审计必须以行动结案（搬家、出走、改遗嘱、改日程），只产生感悟不产生行动的清算视为未完成。深意在于：人是唯一能把死亡预装进决策的动物，临终视角是人类独有的折现率——它能把社会默认配置（更多、更高、更久）整体重估。代价是：折现率一旦调高就收不回，它与家庭义务、法律与共同体的冲突会一路走到离家出走；且清算可能成为新的表演（托尔斯泰终生警惕自己的『圣化冲动』）。现代对应物是临终关怀的『人生回顾疗法』、memento mori 的斯多葛练习与遗产及伦理遗嘱的提前安排。
modes.definition_en: The turn of 1881 was that audit's most thorough execution: at forty-eight, the most famous living writer in Europe, he moved his family from a respectable Moscow house into a peasant's lodging and declared that art, property, and family honor had all depreciated under death's view. A Confession had already supplied the working papers: 'My question was not how to live but what my living means—if the end is death, all accumulation is a transfer toward zero.' For thirty years after he kept running the deathbed audit: daily diary re-checks of vanity and self-deception, property progressively transferred out, at eighty-one walking out of home to make himself an outright exile (dying at Astapovo station). The method has three cores. First, set death as the ruler—not rhetoric but procedure: every holding (position, house, fame, quarrel) must answer 'what is it worth on the last day in bed'; whatever cannot answer goes on the liquidation list. Second, depreciated assets are transferred first: liquidation is not renunciation but transfer—property to those who need it, copyright to the public, time to those present; the transferee is itself evidence of the repricing. Third, action as final review: the audit must close in action (moving, leaving, rewriting the will, rewriting the schedule); a settlement that produces only insights and no acts is ruled incomplete. The deeper point: humans are the only animals that can preinstall death in decision, and the deathbed view is a discount rate unique to our species—able to reprice the whole of society's default configuration (more, higher, longer). The cost: once raised, the discount rate cannot be pulled back; its conflict with family duty, law, and community runs all the way to leaving home; and the audit can become a new performance (Tolstoy was vigilant, lifelong, against his own 'saintliness impulse'). Modern analogues: life-review therapy in hospice care, Stoic memento mori practice, and the early arrangement of wills and ethical wills.
modes.source_chapter: 《忏悔录》（1882）；1881 年迁居莫斯科农夫公寓；1910 年 10 月 28 日离家出走，11 月 7 日卒于阿斯塔波沃车站
modes.key_quote_zh: 如果终点是死，一切积累都是向零的转账——把每一天先按最后一天定价，再决定今天做什么。
modes.key_quote_en: If the end is death, all accumulation is a transfer toward zero—price each day at its last-day value first, then decide what to do today.
process_zh: 建立清算表：定期（每年/每季）列出全部重要持有（财物、职位、名声、关系、日程），逐项以临终视角重新定价
标记贬值项与升值项：在死亡视角下贬值的（体面、积累、纠纷）与升值的（关系、给予、当下）分列，作为后续资源配置的依据
转让贬值项：对贬值项执行可核验的转让或退出（赠与、放弃、拒绝、搬离），转让本身作为定价证据留档
行动终审与防表演：每轮清算以具体行动结案；同时自我审查是否存在『以清算表演道德』的冲动，保持清单私密与平实
process_en: Build the liquidation list: periodically (yearly or quarterly) list every major holding (property, position, fame, relations, schedule) and reprice each under the deathbed view

Mark the depreciated and the appreciated: list separately what depreciates under death's view (respectability, accumulation, quarrels) and what appreciates (relations, giving, the present), as the basis for reallocating resources
Transfer the depreciated: execute verifiable transfer or exit on the depreciated items (gift, renunciation, refusal, moving out), keeping the transfers on record as evidence of the repricing

Final review in action, with a guard against performance: close each round of audit in concrete acts; at the same time self-examine any impulse 'to perform virtue through liquidation,' keeping the list private and plain
representative_cases_zh: 《忏悔录》：审计底稿本身——功名顶点时逐项问『这在我死时有何价值』，问倒了自己的全部成就
1881 年迁居：从贵族宅邸搬进农夫公寓并亲自做鞋、扫地——清算表上的贬值项（仆役、体面）当场清零
1910 年离家出走：81 岁的最后一次行动终审——把自己从荣誉、家族与财产的最后一次持有中退出，死于途中
反例警示：他笔下伊凡·伊里奇的审计缺位——一辈子未做临终定价，直到死前三个月才被迫补做，账已无法调整
representative_cases_en: A Confession: the audit's working papers—at the summit of fame asking item by item 'what is this worth at my death,' until every achievement fell to the question
The move of 1881: from a noble's house into a peasant's lodging, making his own shoes and sweeping floors—depreciated items on the list (servants, respectability) zeroed on the spot
The flight of 1910: the last review in action at eighty-one—withdrawing himself from his final holdings of honor, family, and property, dying on the road
Counter-case: the audit's absence in his Ivan Ilyich—life priced only in the last three months, forced retroactively, when the books could no longer be adjusted
modern_applications_zh: 个人年度审计：以『最后一天值多少』重估日程与持有，据此设定捐赠、退出与减法计划
职业选择：用临终折现率校准Offer——凡只为积累与体面的选项降权，凡为关系与当下的选项加权的显式规则
遗产与伦理遗嘱：生前完成财产、数字资产与意愿的可核验安排，把身后从纠纷区移入转让区
临终关怀实践：以人生回顾与未完成清算为核心工作——帮助被试者在还能行动时完成转让与和解
modern_applications_en: Annual personal audit: reprice one's schedule and holdings by 'worth what on the last day,' setting giving, exit, and subtraction plans accordingly
Career choice: calibrate offers with the deathbed discount rate—explicit rules downweighting options valued only for accumulation and respectability, upweighting those for relations and the present
Wills and ethical wills: complete verifiable arrangements of property, digital assets, and wishes while alive, moving the after-death from the dispute zone into the transfer zone
Hospice practice: making life review and the unfinished liquidation the core work—helping subjects complete transfers and reconciliations while they can still act
